subject: URGENT: venue kit scan failures — serialized QR labels misaligned
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@kitsco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Issue found on-site: QR labels not scanning / shifted print

Hi Logan —

We had the first pallet get staged at the BayCity loading dock this morning and ops reported an abnormal scan failure rate when they ran the serialized QR pass. Rough summary:
- ~18% of labels returned a scan error (no code read) on the handhelds.
- Failures clustered toward the bottom-right corner of the label; looks like a registration/offset issue rather than damage in transit.
- We pulled 12 sample kits and photographed the issue (attached photos_label_misprint.jpg).

I ran the QC batch against the CSV you provided and attached our annotated checklist (qc_checklist.xlsx). It looks like the labels from press run #3 shifted ~3–4mm on average. We can reprint a corrective sheet but that will take a minimum of 72 hours plus rush freight to get to the venue.

Immediate options:
1) We can supply a short-run corrective label sheet for onsite peel-and-replace (fastest, but manual labor at venue).
2) Reprint full corrected run and overnight to venue (recommended for scale but slower).
3) Provide a temporary barcode overlay sticker our team can apply to affected kits (cheapest but less polished).

I attached the photos, our annotated QC checklist, and a sample CSV of serials we validated (kit_serial_numbers_csv.csv).

Let me know which option you prefer and whether Redwood will cover the rush cost for reprint/overnight.

—Sarah
Sarah Kim
Operations Manager, KitsCo
Attachment(s): photos_label_misprint.jpg, qc_checklist.xlsx, kit_serial_numbers_csv.csv

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodai.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@kitsco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Issue found on-site: QR labels not scanning / shifted print

Thanks for the quick triage and the attachments, Sarah.

Marissa / Mina — looping you in since this impacts on-site kit verification tomorrow (we have 1,200 kits for the expo). Key asks:
- Can we confirm whether the misprinted labels are confined to press run #3 (Sarah's note) or affect other runs? Sarah, does your CSV map runs to pallet IDs?
- If we go with option 1 (peel-and-replace), ops at BayCity would need an installed volunteer crew and ~4 hours for full replacement; cost to us would be labor + labels + local travel.
- If we go with reprint + overnight to venue, estimate lead time and cost so we can get approval.

Immediate decision requested: pick replacement strategy so Sarah can start prepping materials. If Redwood covers rush shipping, I'll authorize today. Otherwise, we should triage which SKUs to prioritize (VIP kits only?) to reduce cost.

Logan
Logan Wright
Events & Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): none

From: Sarah Kim <sarah@kitsco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T07:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Issue found on-site: QR labels not scanning / shifted print

Logan —

Confirmed: the shift is isolated to press run #3 (pallet IDs P-003 / P-004). The CSV maps serial ranges to pallet IDs (see kit_serial_numbers_csv.csv, column D). We can do either:

Option A (peel-and-replace):
- We’ll print corrective sticker sheets (500 sheets) using the corrected registration. KitsCo crew can deliver labeled sheets and a two-person team to apply at BayCity.
- ETA to venue: 24 hours (same-city courier).
- Ops time estimate: 4–6 hours depending on volunteer availability.
- Cost estimate: $1,200 (materials + local labor + courier).

Option B (reprint full labels and overnight):
- Full corrected run, printed + varnish, overnight air to venue.
- ETA: 72 hours (press scheduling) + overnight.
- Cost estimate: $4,800 (press + rush freight).

Option C (overlay barcode sticker):
- Small white barcode overlays we can supply; quick to apply but look less premium.
- ETA: 12 hours. Cost: $450.

I attached a new label proof (label_proof_v3.pdf) with the corrected registration marks. If you want KitsCo to proceed with Option A today, we’ll begin printing and schedule courier.

—Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah@kitsco.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Issue found on-site: QR labels not scanning / shifted print

Logan / Mina —

Given the timeline and the customer experience risk at the expo, I recommend we do Option A (peel-and-replace) for all affected pallets (P-003 / P-004) and Option C (overlay) as a contingency for any borderline pieces. Budget cap: $1,500. Sarah — proceed with Option A and include overlays in the courier in case teams hit a high failure rate.

Mina — please confirm routing of funds (charge to events budget S-EXPO-2027) so KitCo can invoice and we can authorize payment. Also confirm volunteer crew plan with BayCity (we'll allocate two on-site CS staff for oversight).

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: BayCity Events Ops <ops@baycityevents.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah@kitsco.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: venue kit scan failures — serialized QR labels misaligned

Hi all —

Quick update from the floor. We received the peel-and-replace kits this morning and BayCity ops completed the replacement on pallet P-003 overnight. Post-replacement scan run: 1.8% error (within expected handheld tolerance). We also received the overlay stickers and used them on a ~30-kit sample — overlays scanned cleanly with no visible registration issues.

Attached photos (uploaded to our shared folder) but short version: the corrected labels match your CSV and handhelds are reading serials consistently. We returned the failed samples to KitsCo for root-cause follow-up.

Thanks for quick turnaround — please proceed with invoicing per the agreed $1,200.

—Jared from BayCity Ops
Attachment(s): shared_drive_link://baycity/ops/expo2027/kit_qc_photos
